messages:
Maya: Customer POC failed with 413 when sending a single huge convo blob (~4.8MB). Need a demo tomorrow.
Jin: Which endpoint/model? Hosted chat.generate?
Maya: Hosted, model redwood-chat-32k. Error returned by gateway: 413 Request Entity Too Large.
Rory: Gateway has a 2MB body cap for hosted. Quick fixes: presign+pointer, gzip body (Content-Encoding), or split into multiple requests.
Maya: They can't refactor client much. Presign sounds best. Can we provide a one-off presign flow for POC?
Rory: Yes. We can issue a short-lived presign and run a transient ingest summarizer so the model receives a small summary. Presign policy: expire in 10m, single PUT, TLS only.
Maya: Security wants audit & retention guarantees.
Rory: We'll log object_id, set private ACL, and schedule auto-delete in 24h for demo. Flagging that Dedicated is recommended for long-term.
Jin: Also remind them about token limits: 32k token model still truncates. Suggest semantic chunking or retrieval for very long docs.
Maya: I'll send the presign how-to and a tiny curl example, plus ask for Content-Length to confirm.
InfraBot: prod-gw: upstream 413 recorded for client 18.205.34.12.
Maya: Thanks team — sending to customer now.
